environment: Linux with JDK 21. Use an isolated clean exact-head checkout and required build locks. Retain fresh logs and JUnit XML. No Gradle or tests on Windows. Use a normal clone for root check if Antora rejects linked-worktree .git pointer.
head: f9988d951a5e15546fcd3b36659a67cc74d0795a
requirements: Verify fork observable-test ref is exactly assigned head, public PR 5314 remains at base, and base is an ancestor of assigned head. Stop and reconcile changes; this is a separate branch and must not move the PR head.

Run the focused real-ZooKeeper test org.apache.solr.client.solrj.impl.CloudHttp2SolrClientTest.testZkAliasDoesNotReadAliasCollectionState with seeds 18606CAFE and 18606BEEF in fresh executions. It must execute, pass without skips, and show its direct missing-state getData positive control was actually observed before checking the three real alias queries. Record XML and logs; do not accept a missing/uncounted positive control as proof.

On a separate clean assigned-head checkout remove only the ZkClientClusterStateProvider known-alias guard (preserve ref != null). Run the new alias test: the direct missing-read positive control must pass and the final count assertion must fail because actual alias queries produce observed alias state reads. Record runtime assertion and counts; setup or compilation failure is not evidence. Restore mutation. This test checks real ZooKeeper I/O, not p99 latency.

Run ./gradlew :solr:solrj:test --tests org.apache.solr.client.solrj.impl.ClusterStateProviderTest --tests org.apache.solr.client.solrj.impl.CloudSolrClientCacheTest --tests org.apache.solr.client.solrj.impl.CloudSolrClientRoutingTest --tests org.apache.solr.client.solrj.impl.CloudHttp2SolrClientTest.testHttpCspPerf --tests org.apache.solr.client.solrj.impl.CloudHttp2SolrClientTest.testAliasHandling -Ptests.seed=18606CAFE. Require moved testProviderRefreshesCollectionMissingFromLocalState, testProviderUnknownCollection, testProviderPropagatesCollectionReadFailures, testSyncWaitsForCallbackAndPropagatesFailure, and retained testMissingCollectionIsCheckedOncePerRequest to execute and pass without skips. ClusterStateProviderTest is parameterized; report per-variant execution, failures, skips and counts.

On separate clean head checkouts, mutate only one item per run: remove provider sync then run moved testProviderUnknownCollection and require expected interaction-order failure; disable the sync helper await conditional then run moved testSyncWaitsForCallbackAndPropagatesFailure and require expected timeout assertion failure; remove client-provider reclassification of wrapped reader errors then run moved testProviderPropagatesCollectionReadFailures and require expected SERVER_ERROR versus BAD_REQUEST assertion failure. Record runtime assertions, not build/setup failures; restore each mutation.

On a separate clean head checkout, make getState return its existing local collection reference without performing the miss refresh, retaining a compilable implementation. Run moved testProviderRefreshesCollectionMissingFromLocalState and require the missing-reference assertion to fail. This verifies the relocated real-ZooKeeper test still detects the original stale-view defect.

Run ./gradlew :solr:core:test --tests org.apache.solr.cloud.overseer.ZkStateReaderTest --tests org.apache.solr.cloud.AliasIntegrationTest and ./gradlew :solr:solrj-zookeeper:test --tests org.apache.solr.common.cloud.SolrZkClientTest with seed 18606CAFE. Report actual XML counts and skipped tests.

Run ./gradlew tidy and ./gradlew --no-daemon check -x test on the exact head, including :solr:core:validateSourcePatterns. A tracked formatting change invalidates the head; report it without modifying or pushing. State material environment conditions and any interrupted attempts.

Report limitations: the ZooKeeper debug-log filter is version/format dependent and is proved only for the exercised session and request path; the test detects repeated ZooKeeper reads rather than measuring latency or p99. The real cluster uses one ZooKeeper server and does not prove ensemble lag. Stale alias refresh remains out of scope. Do not claim Docker-dependent or Windows/Cygwin proof.
verdict_policy: Pass only when all named positive tests, two-seed real-ZK signal proof, each isolated runtime mutation, tidy and root check pass at the exact head without skips in required tests; include fresh evidence and executor cleanup.
